subject: Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning (DILR)
exam_context: CAT 2026 - DILR section only, 22 questions / 66 marks / 40 minutes
data_provenance: Estimated from slot-wise PYQ analyses of CAT 2021-2025 aggregated by multiple coaching trackers, not an official IIM-published weightage document; last grounded Sep 2026. Set-type mix (DI-heavy vs LR-heavy vs blended) varies noticeably slot to slot within the same year, more so than in VARC or QA, so treat as a directional multi-year average only.

D01.area: Data Interpretation - Tables, Bar/Line Graphs, Pie Charts
D01.notes: CAT 2024 trend data flagged Line & Bar Graphs at ~18% of DILR sets; pure-DI sets have declined somewhat relative to blended DI-LR caselets in recent slots.

D02.notes: Consistently the largest and most time-consuming DILR category; multi-constraint puzzles are the section's classic 'make-or-break' sets.

D03.notes: CAT 2024/2025 trend data flagged Games & Tournaments as one of the highest-weightage single set-types, a shift from more DI-heavy papers pre-2022.

D04.area: Reasoning-based Sets - Venn Diagrams, Binary/Selection Logic, Networks
D04.notes: Venn-diagram-based sets recur most reliably within this bucket; pure binary-logic sets appear less often than arrangement/tournament sets.

marking_scheme.source_note: Confirmed via multiple Sep 2026 sources reporting on the CAT 2025 (30 Nov 2025) session, consistent with the CAT 2024 pattern.
marking_scheme.mcq: +3 for a correct answer, -1 for an incorrect answer, 0 if unattempted.
marking_scheme.tita: +3 for a correct answer, 0 for an incorrect answer (no negative marking), 0 if unattempted.
marking_scheme.mcq_tita_split_typical: Approximately 12-14 MCQs and 8-10 TITA questions per slot, varying by set composition.
marking_scheme.question_types_used: Single-correct MCQ and TITA (type-in-the-answer). No multiple-correct or matrix-match formats.
